sources.title: CloudSurf-4B-FC API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: The model's native interface is prompt-mode (Gemma-4 turn format, bracket tool-call lists). For harnesses that speak the OpenAI chat/tools API — including tau2-bench — this repo ships the exact serving bridge used for our τ²-bench leaderboard runs: serving/fc_tau2_bridge.py (stdlib-only, no dependencies).
